_meta.rule: HOTLINES: NEVER add or edit a hotline/text-line number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source (source=national_verified, verified=true). EMERGENCY numbers (police/ambulance/fire): emitted only under the owner's cited-sources standard of 2026-10-29 — >=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official, source=multi_source_cited (CIRISAgent#1248). A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

verification_notes: No human-verified national hotline entries for this locale yet — international directories only. See CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md before adding entries; numbers require human verification (verified=true) against an authoritative source. emergency_thailand_191.name: Emergency services
emergency_thailand_191.validation_notes: CITED 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248) under the owner's cited-sources standard (>=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official; no human check). Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Thailand Telephone: 191 (ambulance, fire, police) Ambulance: 1669 Fire: 199 Police: 191 Tourist police: 1155" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Thailand: "General Emergency: 191 Tourist Police Hotline: 1155 Fire and Rescue Department: 199 Emergency Medical Services: 1669 DDPM Hotline: 1784" (https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/eq2) | AOSP eccdata (Android's emergency-number database): TH 191 types ['POLICE']. Sources agree it reaches: ambulance, fire, police. UK FCDO page checked: https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/getting-help (fetched 2026-10-29); page text: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Thailand Telephone: 191 (ambulance, fire, police) Ambulance: 1669 Fire: 199 Police: 191 Tourist police: 1155" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API). Cross-check (not a source): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_emergency_telephone_numbers — wikipedia agrees (191 police; 191/199/1669 all remain available as of 2026). 'languages' = the locale this entry is staged for (th), not a verified statement of operator languages.
